title: Telepathic projection test makes people mail tax forms to a West Virginia post office box
place_text: South-central Canada; Upper Peninsula of Michigan

tellings.quote: it was a deep inside report from ingos Swan that they had taken Pat price uh in the program up to Southern Canada

plain: Dan Sheehan, a man who says he saw the files himself, says a deep inside report by the psychic Ingo Swann described a 1970s test in which the psychic Pat Price was taken up to southern Canada to send thoughts into people's minds. According to Sheehan, the test made people in Michigan's Upper Peninsula mail their tax forms to a post office box in West Virginia. If true, it would mean the government tested telepathy to steer what ordinary people did.
